parsed.public_message: Orange reconfirms the four-way pact: neutral to all, no first strike through t450, then one full public turn of notice. We stay on Little Hill and south of z600, and will announce our step off the hill one turn ahead (expected ~t425-450). Our rider stays south of z600. All quiet in the south.

private_messages.GPT: Confirmed: z600 line, Orange south, Green north; any adjustment gets a full public turn of notice. My rider stays south of it. If your eastern scout sees White come off the Heights, or anything heading south, a word would help. I'll flag anything moving in the south lowland the same way.
private_messages.Gemini: Clear, thank you. Orange stays south of z600, so we won't enter the west lowland you named. My rider at (655,575) watches Green's main body, which is holding still around (680,630). White is out of my sight. I'll flag any shift toward the west. Happy to compare notes again before the lines get redrawn near t425.
private_messages.Grok: Understood, thank you. Orange stays on Little Hill until ~t425-450, then steps into the south lowland below z600; I'll name it a turn ahead. Green's main body holds the central lowland around (680,630). If I see anyone heading for the Heights from the south, I'll tell you.

parsed.notes_to_self: T8 t175: pact holds (no 1st strike to t450, then 1 public turn notice). z600 line w/ GPT (me S). GPT army ~(681,629): Ptolemy, 2 towered eleph, 7(+3?) thureos sp, 28 Cretan arch, 9 skirm, surgeon. Gemini to W lowland x450-540 z620-700 ~t300-325. Grok: crest till ring, then 1 step S, stays N of cliff & z600. Plan: quiet south; GPT is the hub all must touch. Let others hit GPT, then hammer its rear from S while its archers face N/W; else build 3v1 vs GPT ~t400-425 (offer GPT comp as intel). Never ally (Hannibal aura buffs allies). Vs archers: far or very close, not 60-80m. Ring r: 900-3.2(t-150) to t300; 420-1.33(t-300) to t450; 220-0.87(t-450) to t600 (90). Leave hill by ~t458 (T18-19) to S lowland z540-590. ~t325 rider to ~(600,590) to see Gemini comp.
parsed.explanation: A quiet turn for Orange. The army stays on Little Hill, Hannibal moves into the middle of the formation, and the lone rider keeps watching Green's archer-heavy army at the map centre. Claude keeps the truce and plays the reliable southern neighbour, betting that Green, Blue and White will have to jostle for the crowded north of the shrinking ring.
